headline: Main suspect arrested for torturing 2-month-old baby in Narsingdi
summary: RAB-11 arrested Farzana Akter in Narayanganj, the primary accused in a case involving the torture of an infant whose video went viral on social media.
details: RAB-11 arrested Farzana Akter, alias Lota, the primary suspect in a case involving the torture of a two-month-old baby in Narsingdi. She was apprehended during an operation in the Rupganj area of Narayanganj on Friday afternoon.
The arrest follows a viral video showing Farzana entering a room and twisting the leg of the infant while the mother was away. The child began screaming in pain immediately after the act.
The victim is the second child of Zahirul Haque and Saeba Begum from Paikardi village in Madhabdi. Farzana is the wife of the child's uncle, Kaushar Haque.
A case was filed on July 14 by probation officer Riza Akter. The case named Farzana, her husband Kaushar Ahmed, and her father Almas Mia as suspects.
While Kaushar and Almas were arrested shortly after the case was filed, Farzana had remained in hiding until her recent capture.
The probation officer stated that the incident stemmed from financial disputes and personal conflicts between the two wives in the joint family.
Farzana has been handed over to Madhabdi Police Station and is expected to be produced before a Narsingdi court on Saturday.
RAB-11 officials emphasized their 'zero tolerance' policy toward crimes involving the torture of women and children.
caption:
A woman has been arrested after a viral video showed her twisting the leg of a 2-month-old baby.

RAB-11 arrested Farzana Akter, alias Lota, the primary suspect in a case involving the torture of a two-month-old baby in Narsingdi. She was apprehended during an operation in the Rupganj area of Narayanganj on Friday afternoon.

The arrest follows a viral video showing Farzana entering a room and twisting the leg of the infant while the mother was away. The child began screaming in pain immediately after the act.

The victim is the second child of Zahirul Haque and Saeba Begum from Paikardi village in Madhabdi. Farzana is the wife of the child's uncle, Kaushar Haque.

A case was filed on July 14 by probation officer Riza Akter. The case named Farzana, her husband Kaushar Ahmed, and her father Almas Mia as suspects.

While Kaushar and Almas were arrested shortly after the case was filed, Farzana had remained in hiding until her recent capture.

The probation officer stated that the incident stemmed from financial disputes and personal conflicts between the two wives in the joint family.

Farzana has been handed over to Madhabdi Police Station and is expected to be produced before a Narsingdi court on Saturday.

RAB-11 officials emphasized their 'zero tolerance' policy toward crimes involving the torture of women and children.
